messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Fixed according to the project docs: only lower move counts replace a size’s best, and unfinished sizes show `Best: none`.

Typecheck, build, and 140 unit tests passed. All 77 browser checks passed across the full run and one artwork-timeout retry. Changed files pass formatting; the full formatting check flags 13 untouched files.
